visual_logic.color_palette: Deep sea-foam green dorsal skin with dark forest-green 'racing stripes' along the entire neck; pale cream-colored underbelly.
visual_logic.texture: Smooth, matte clay finish with high-gloss finish on the eyes and inside the mouth.
visual_logic.action: A full-body horizontal profile view stretching completely from the left edge to the right edge of the frame. The massive, 14-meter body is aligned perfectly flat in the upper half of the image, keeping the bottom half clear so a second species can easily be drawn or stacked directly beneath it for side-by-side length comparison. Rather than curving its long neck into a double 'S' shape, its extraordinarily long neck is extended out perfectly straight and horizontal along the tracking line to showcase its full length.

environment.water: Slate blue water with long, horizontal underwater sunbeams cutting straight across the wide frame to establish a clear tracking line.
environment.biota: A school of small, silver-clay Enchodus fish darting horizontally in the background plane through the particulates (marine snow).
